findings.message: uses pull_request_target — verify no head SHA/ref is checked out
findings.remediation: Ensure pull_request_target does not access github.event.pull_request.head.*
findings.impact: pull_request_target runs with base-repository privileges, so later use of untrusted event data can compromise the repository.
findings.attack_vector: A privileged pull_request_target job consumes PR-controlled text, artifacts, or revisions without a safe boundary.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: sensitive GitHub token permissions: pull-requests:write
findings.remediation: Grant write scopes only to the job that needs them and keep all other scopes read-only or none.
findings.impact: A compromised workflow step can modify repository content, packages, deployments, checks, or security records within the granted scope.
findings.attack_vector: A permissions block grants a named write scope; exploitability depends on whether untrusted code reaches that job.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: references 1 action or reusable workflow ref(s) that are not pinned to a full commit SHA
findings.remediation: Pin third-party actions and reusable workflows to a full 40-character commit SHA.
findings.impact: Mutable action refs can change without a workflow diff if the upstream tag or branch is moved.
findings.attack_vector: A workflow uses @main, @master, a version tag, or another ref instead of a full commit SHA.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: decodes obfuscated payload and executes it in the same file
findings.remediation: Remove all decode-and-execute patterns; they are strongly correlated with malicious behavior.
findings.impact: Decoded payload executed in same file — classic obfuscation-to-RCE pattern.
findings.attack_vector: Buffer.from(base64).toString() → eval() chain; the base64 payload is invisible to static review.
findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.

findings.message: dynamically imports code from a variable path

findings.risk_adjustment: No automatic downgrade: risk changes require explicit protective controls.
